_note: Written by scripts/frozengate.js --write, reasons by hand. Every key needs a REASON, and "it looked fine" is not one - six of these shipped as bugs before the gate existed, four of them found by the owner. SURFACE / MARK / KEPT / SETTLED are the only four arguments that have ever been valid here; anything that is not one of those is a bug, not an entry.
